patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-fashion photography and video are used as dominant background elements for most sections, creating an immersive visual experience.
A very large, bold, golden-yellow serif typeface is used exclusively for the brand name and major section headings, creating a strong brand identity and visual hierarchy.
A high-contrast dark theme with a dominant black background is consistently paired with a distinctive golden-yellow accent color for branding and key text elements.
The hero section features the brand name text dynamically interacting with a full-bleed video background, appearing to parallax or stick as the user scrolls before eventually disappearing.
The primary navigation bar transforms from a transparent, minimal state with a promotional banner to a solid black, sticky bar with simplified links after scrolling past the hero.

technique_notes: A smooth scrolling library (like locomotive-scroll) is employed to create a fluid and controlled scroll experience across the page.

The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video background with a large, branded text overlay that exhibits a parallax or sticky effect, appearing to float over the video content as the user scrolls before animating out of view.

The site employs a dynamic header that transitions from an initial transparent state with a top banner to a fixed, solid black navigation bar with simplified links once the user scrolls past the hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold serif display font for the brand name and section titles (~4-5x body text), contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body and product details. Uppercase is used for labels and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (mostly square edges, product images are rectangular).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections, ample padding around content blocks, especially in the hero and full-bleed image sections).

standout: The site's distinctive use of an extremely large, bold, golden-yellow serif typeface for its brand name and key section titles, combined with a deep black background and full-bleed, high-fashion photography, creates a luxurious and editorial aesthetic. The hero text's unique parallaxing or sticky behavior over the video further enhances this premium feel, making the brand name a central, dynamic visual element.
